line: An AI can talk about Minecraft. But can it see your world?
caption: An AI needs more than words.
fr: Une IA a besoin de plus que des mots.

line: Mine M C P connects your AI agent to the real Minecraft client.
caption: Connect your AI to your Minecraft client.
fr: Connecte ton IA à ton client Minecraft.

line: First, observe. Read your player, nearby blocks, and the contents of an open chest.
caption: Observe the client. Read the open chest.
fr: Observe le client et le coffre ouvert.

line: Then act. Transfer an item through the same inventory controls a player uses.
caption: Act through normal player controls.
fr: Agis avec les contrôles du joueur.

line: Verify the result. Twelve diamonds are now in the player's inventory.
caption: Verify: 12 diamonds in the inventory.

line: Forty five tools. Screenshots, movement, chat, inventory, and more. Press F eight to pause AI control.
caption: 45 tools. Press F8 to pause control.

line: Install Fabric. Add the mod. Connect an M C P compatible AI. Start with Mine M C P on CurseForge.
caption: Fabric. Mine MCP. Your connected AI.
fr: Fabric. Mine MCP. Ton IA connectée.
